description: Saves the result of a check as a report page the person can open and share, kept 30 days, and returns its link. Use it only when the person asks for a link to the results or a report to share. Pass the resultId that seo_audit_page, check_robots_sitemap_llms_txt, check_ai_crawler_access, check_agent_readiness, compare_with_competitor_page or check_local_seo_details returned; it stays valid for one hour after the check, and the same resultId always gives the same link. result has tool and url (the check and page the report covers) and reportUrl is the report page. An unknown or expired resultId is an error: run the check again, then share it. Recorded: the tool and the app name.

resultId.description: The resultId a check returned: 22 letters, digits, "-" or "_".

name: share_report
title: Save a shareable report
